claims: The 2026 U.S. Open Golf Championship is the 126th edition.
The 2026 U.S. Open Golf Championship will be held June 18–21, 2026.
The 2026 U.S. Open Golf Championship will be held at Shinnecock Hills Golf Club in Southampton, New York.
The U.S. Open Golf Championship is one of golf’s four major championships.
The U.S. Open Golf Championship features 72 holes of stroke play.
The U.S. Open Golf Championship has a $21.5 million+ purse.
The USGA generally holds the U.S. Open Golf Championship.
Bryson DeChambeau won the 2024 U.S. Open at Pinehurst.
Wyndham Clark won the 2023 U.S. Open.
Matt Fitzpatrick won the 2022 U.S. Open.
Tickets for the 2026 U.S. Open Golf Championship are available.
Special packages for the 1895 Club or Trophy Club are available at USGA Experiences for the 2026 U.S. Open Golf Championship.
The 2027 U.S. Open will be at Pebble Beach Golf Links in Pebble Beach, Calif.
The 2028 U.S. Open will be at Winged Foot Golf Club in Mamaroneck, N.Y.
The 2029 U.S. Open will be at Pinehurst Resort & C.C. in Pinehurst, N.C.
Winners of the past five Masters, PGA Championships, and Open Championships are eligible for the U.S. Open.
Top 10 finishers from the previous year's U.S. Open are eligible.
Winners of the Players Championship and current year PGA Tour events are eligible for the U.S. Open.
Top-ranked players from the Official World Golf Ranking (OWGR) are eligible for the U.S. Open.
Players who advance through local/final qualifying are eligible for the U.S. Open.
